data.name: Prithviraj
data.gender_notes: Prithviraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Prithviraj means 'Ruler of the Universe'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Prithvi' which means 'earth' and 'Raj' which means 'king' or 'ruler'. This name is often given to boys born into royal families or those who are destined to become leaders and rulers in their own right. The name Prithviraj carries the meaning “Ruler of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prithviraj usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prithviraj is a powerful name that represents the inner strength and courage of an individual. It symbolizes the ability to rule over one's own life and the universe around them. It is a name that inspires confidence and respect, and is often associated with leadership, power, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Prithviraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prithviraj total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Prithviraj' carries a rich cultural significance, as it is associated with regal power, authority, and sovereignty. In Hindu mythology and history, there is a legendary king named Prithviraj Chauhan, who was known for his bravery, valor, and leadership qualities. He was the last Hindu king of Delhi who ruled from the fortress of Chandangarh. The saga of his life and his battles against the invading forces of Muhammad Ghori have been popularized in various forms of Indian literature and art. The name 'Prithviraj' continues to be a source of inspiration and pride for many Hindus, particularly those who trace their ancestry back to the noble and courageous rulers of medieval India.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Prithviraj' represents the innate desire and potential for each individual to rule over their own minds and hearts, and ultimately, their own destinies. The Universe is vast and infinite, and each one of us is a small part of it. To be a 'Prithviraj' spiritually is to recognize our inner king or queen, and to strive to become the masters of our thoughts, emotions, and actions. It is a call to conquer our inner demons and weaknesses, and to sovereignly guide our lives towards the path of dharma, artha, kama, and moksha. It is a reminder that each one of us has the power to rule our own lives, and to make a positive impact on the world around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Prithviraj translates to 'Ruler of the Earth'. This name is a symbol of power, strength, and rule over material desires. It represents an individual's unwavering determination to conquer their inner demons and rule their minds, ultimately attaining control over their earthly existence.

vedic_reference.note: Prithviraj Chauhan was a famous king in the medieval India. He is the protagonist of the Indian epic Prithviraj Raso.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Prithviraj Chauhan was a Rajput king who ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1179 to 1192. The name Prithviraj carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Prithviraj Chauhan is most famous for his battles against Muhammad Ghori.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Prithviraj remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
